title: Chapter 87 Mud Puppet
content:
Chapter 87 Mud Puppet

When Wang Shuo saw this skill, the first person he thought of was Gong Zheng.

He planned to train him into a tank, and this skill was tailor-made for him.

"Is the price negotiable?"

"This skill book can be said to be priceless. I am also very optimistic about the Lord, and I hope that we can still have the opportunity to cooperate, so I took it out."

"100,000 is 100,000." Wang Shuo gritted his teeth and agreed decisively.

"Do you still have the "Thought Seal" scroll?" Wang Shuo thought about it and asked again.

"There are 10 more." Hadro said casually, thinking for a while, "These 10 will be the extra for this transaction!"

Hearing Hadro's words, Wang Shuo was a little embarrassed.

After all, the transaction volume this time has reached 200,000 gold coins, and he still wants to bargain again.

In this way, Wang Shuo can't bring himself to bargain again.

[Thunderbolt × 1500, Wall Defense Talisman × 200, Bronze Crossbow Construction Drawing × 1, "Petrification" Skill Book × 1, Thought Stamp Scroll × 10, Gold Coins - 20,000, Energy Crystals - 18,000. ]

Transaction completed.

Wang Shuo asked again: "Mr. Hadro, do you know which beasts will attack my village this time?"

Hadro smiled and shook his head, saying: "Lord, I can't say for sure. The monsters in each place are different, but basically they are some monsters near your territory."

It was almost the same as Wang Shuo's guess.

Hadro was sent away.

Wang Shuo quickly handed the bronze crossbow construction drawing to Matar.

"Matar, no matter what, you must build a crossbow tomorrow morning. Can you do it?"

Wang Shuo gave him a death order.

This was obviously contrary to their previous agreement.

Matar looked at the blueprint. Although he was a little embarrassed, he still promised Wang Shuo: "I will do my best to build one for the lord."

Then Wang Shuo found Suo Yong and summoned all the masons.

Wang Shuo planned to turn the outer wall of his territory into a swamp, which could effectively block the attack of wild beasts.

Wang Shuo led everyone to collect a large amount of water from the pond in the territory, and then began to build a mud pit outside the wall.

Not long after, Wang Shuo showed disappointment.

The idea is beautiful, but the reality is very skinny.

Because their efficiency is a bit low.

But it's better than nothing!

Wang Shuo comforted himself.

At this time, he noticed that his skill of summoning mud monsters was almost full.

He quickly summoned it twice, and the system prompt sounded.

[The skill of summoning mud monsters is upgraded to summoning mud puppets. 】

Wang Shuo was stunned for a moment. The mud monster left me?

He quickly summoned a mud puppet.

[Mud Golem]

[Level: Level 10]

[Attack: 35]

[Defense: 50]

[HP: 2000]

[Skill: Taunt]

[Evaluation: A golem born in mud, as a summoner, it is a very good melee cannon fodder! ]

Wang Shuo simply ignored the cannon fodder, but it has a taunt skill, which is very good.

If it is in the mud, this golem can still attract hatred very well.

If there are hundreds of them, it would be so cool!

However, it takes 50 points of mental power to summon one, which directly shattered Wang Shuo's beautiful idea.

By the evening, a 2-meter-wide mud was finally created outside the wall.

After Hua Tianxiong and others who went out to level up came back.

Wang Shuo planned to go to the ancient battlefield to see how many military merit points Ayub led the cavalry team to brush.
